title: pp.phiverb~
description: `pp.phiverb~` is an algorithmic, feedback-delay-network-based reverb that processes stereo input and produces stereo output with configurable input filtering, early reflections, late reflections, damping, feedback, and dry/wet mix. Its early and late reflection delay times can be modulated through 8- and 16-channel signal inlets, respectively, and it can save and recall up to 20 presets with the parent patch.
